task: Compare all exacta/trifecta rank patterns and reporting price bands; assess actual price-weighted returns and temporal persistence without prescribing a formation.
shared_universe: Only races with complete validated exacta AND trifecta books and frozen-model predictions; never zero-fill missing prices.
rank_patterns: All distinct rank pairs and triples for every rider count present. No favorite formation, head fixation or preset ticket count.
classification: Primary exacta_band for both markets; separate native trifecta_band as a sensitivity view. Do not merge schemes.
returns: Direct observed return: sum of winning ticket odds / candidate opportunities. Do not multiply pooled hit frequency by mean candidate odds.
persistence_diagnostic: Freeze every primary-scheme cell with early-period observed ROI>100%; report later-period performance of ALL such cells. No sample-size cutoff, no cherry-picking of later winners, no added selection filter. This is a descriptive diagnostic, not an adopted purchase policy.
all_cell_output: Include early/later opportunities, wins, realized ROI and largest-single-win share for all observed cells, including losing and zero-hit cells.
followup_exploration: After the ordered-pattern comparison, pool all2! or3! orders of every unordered rank-member set. Compare every set and price band and repeat the early-positive persistence diagnostic. This additional view is exploratory, not an untouched test or a chosen formation.
pooled_output: Price-band results for all candidates and HIGH/MED+/MED candidates; also retain classification, rider-count and price cross-tabs.
uncertainty: 5000 resamples of whole race days within each half-year; seed20261026. Conditional on the fixed historical data and early-period diagnostic mask; no claim of fresh untouched validation.
control: Replay the unchanged current research rule: HIGH gap>=1 exacta4, S3-HIGH gap>=2 trifecta6,100yen per ticket, whole race skipped if any of exacta4 odds<=4. No policy edits.
limitations: All periods have been viewed before; this is historical temporal consistency analysis, not newly independent proof.
Final quotes only, not purchase-time odds.
135k-style cell searches create severe multiple-comparison and sparse-event risks; positive cells alone are not adoption evidence.
LOW here is a control band of the same research model, not the separate Ura model.
